catalog.name: Evo
catalog.description: "The bodies of new humans will be cockpits. Their limit, the universe." With these words, Abby Shield introduced the Evo, the standard body of every raider.

catalog.name: Beyond
catalog.description: An evolution of Abby’s basic model, designed to carry more powerful weapons.

catalog.name: Lizard Moon
catalog.description: An old Maison Melies design for early Imperial ships, later stolen by Isaac Greyling Foundry. Basic, mid-strength, with no notable features.

catalog.name: Iron Creed
catalog.description: The story goes that the first Iron leader, the Great Apostate, slew so many rivals that he forged a new hull from the pieces of their bodies.

catalog.name: Bios
catalog.description: The HomeInSpace Company designed the Bios for their Mugai mining raiders, seeking durable bodies. They later became the Empire’s main problem in the Mining Soul Revolution.

catalog.name: Iron Lizard
catalog.description: A modification of the Lizard Moon, built by the Iron Guild after several prototypes. To choose the best, raiders were installed in them and fought each other.

catalog.name: Gold Lizard
catalog.description: A modified Lizard Moon based on the original body, enhanced with the famous Injectable Gold used by Gold Guild raiders.

catalog.name: Newcult
catalog.description: The Malaxdon are closed to the world beyond the Tree. Their rejection of traditional modules led them to develop a body grounded in their belief in Balance.

catalog.name: Colonizer
catalog.description: Old Imperial colonies can be a source of great satisfaction, especially when adapting alien ship cockpits for raider bodies. The Colonizer has been tested in some of the Human Empire’s most important expansion wars.

catalog.name: IronSun
catalog.description: The Iron Guild’s latest and greatest body, forged from the capital ship carcasses of past leaders.

catalog.name: Chrysos
catalog.description: Countless experiments were needed to achieve this body. Raiders who wield it spread golden glory across the Imperial colonies.

catalog.name: Recycled IronSun
catalog.description: The Iron Guild’s latest and greatest body, forged from the capital ship carcasses of past leaders. Recycled body.

catalog.name: Recycled Chrysos
catalog.description: Countless experiments were needed to achieve this body. Raiders who wield it spread golden glory across the Imperial colonies. Recycled body.

catalog.name: Eagle
catalog.description: No one sued when Entity stole the "Beyond" trademark from Abbey's Shield. The result is a light, fast, capacious raider body.

catalog.name: Algor
catalog.description: Following its vision of “Realizing the future as if it were already present,” TTF System created the Algor, a prized raider body born from its own AI’s investments.

catalog.name: Zephyros
catalog.description: Derived from imperial suites where users were connected to each other, this tech evolved into a raider body. Zephyros uses connection data to minimize power use.

catalog.name: Talon
catalog.description: Imperial explorers were the first to use this Maison Melies-designed high-pressure hull. Once a simple cockpit, it became a raider hull during early Neterun colonization.

catalog.name: Helicon
catalog.description: Project One Record Though the team is decimated, the Family demands continuity. Mind installation onto Helicon underway. Biological body will be destroyed.

catalog.name: Prism
catalog.description: Sharp like a Mhafek’s pain.

catalog.name: Fibuljet
catalog.description: Designed by HIS to save weight and cost, it was later mass-produced by the colonists of NGCC 97-Aleph.

catalog.name: Nervprop
catalog.description: During the War of the Artifacts, many Imperial explorers might have survived if only they’d had an engine like this.

catalog.name: Flexxor Z9
catalog.description: Kin designed this prosthesis for Imperial veterans, but Behl repurposed it as a raider engine after a subject leapt from orbit.

catalog.name: Ildorboost
catalog.description: Another stroke of genius from Isaac Greyling, who built this engine from a design stolen in Abby Shield’s archives.

catalog.name: EX-S
catalog.description: A low-cost engine from Entity, mass-produced under Old Joe’s motto: ‘If you don’t have anything better, why not this?’

catalog.name: Speeder
catalog.description: Entity brand, a slight improvement over the basic model. Used on Iron and Gold raider ships during the Pact of the Guilds.

catalog.name: Speeder Mod 0
catalog.description: Unauthorized modifications unlocked the S-Engine’s control stakes, creating a new, upgradeable version.

catalog.name: Speeder Mod 1
catalog.description: Unauthorized modifications unlocked the S-Engine’s control stakes, creating a new, upgradeable version.

catalog.name: Speeder Mod 2
catalog.description: Unauthorized modifications unlocked the S-Engine’s control stakes, creating a new, upgradeable version.

catalog.name: Speeder Mod 3
catalog.description: Unauthorized modifications unlocked the S-Engine’s control stakes, creating a new, upgradeable version.

catalog.name: Speeder Mod 4
catalog.description: Unauthorized modifications unlocked the S-Engine’s control stakes, creating a new, upgradeable version.

catalog.name: Irongine
catalog.description: The Iron Raiders tested their engines on prisoners forced to escape the Hole’s gravity. One succeeded, became a guild leader, and his engine was named Irongine.

catalog.name: Boosted S
catalog.description: Right after the Pact of the Guilds, before hostilities resumed, Iron and Gold collaborated to improve the common engine used by their raiders, one of their last peaceful pacts.

catalog.name: Utority Propulser
catalog.description: Cagetastic developed this engine from cage-building drone tech. It proved so efficient that it was repurposed for raider engines.

catalog.name: Propulser 44
catalog.description: Manufactured by HomeInSpace, a safe and reliable engine used by most raiders.

catalog.name: Recycled Propulser 44
catalog.description: Manufactured by HomeInSpace, a fairly safe engine used by most raiders. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Medium Engine (Premium)
catalog.description: Medium Engine (Premium)

catalog.name: Goold Boost
catalog.description: The Gold Guild forged this engine from the rarest Neterun materials, believing it their greatest creation and a tribute to their golden god.

catalog.name: Propulser 44 Mod 0
catalog.description: Home In Space gave elite raiders the codes to build an upgradeable version of their engine, likely in exchange for valuable loot.

catalog.name: Propulser 45
catalog.description: The HIS Propulser 44 patent evolved into this Reduced Transmission model. Save energy and go the distance.

catalog.name: Recycled Propulser 45
catalog.description: The HIS M-engine patent evolved into this Reduced Transmission model. Save energy and go the distance, if you know your way around the galaxy. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Large Engine (Premium)
catalog.description: Large Engine (Premium)

catalog.name: Lon-1
catalog.description: A scout raider weapon used in major colonial wars of the Human Empire. Patented by Tolec.

catalog.name: Lon-2
catalog.description: The Lon-2 keeps all the merits of the Lon-1 while fixing its flaws. A decisive weapon in early raider wars, used in the Guilds’ attack on the Core planet.

catalog.name: Meteor Phaser
catalog.description: Designed by Isaac Greyling, the Meteor Phaser was widely used in the Thornstone region for resource extraction.

catalog.name: Omega Phaser
catalog.description: An old Opal Mhafek project before their extermination. After the war, K&B obtained the original design for free.

catalog.name: Pulser Mk1
catalog.description: A direct evolution of the Mk1, made necessary during the Great Fixing Attack, when the Empire destroyed insurgent colonies.

catalog.name: Pulser Mk2
catalog.description: The latest pulser on the market. Easy to master but expensive, it uses energy storage tech for greater damage than earlier models.

catalog.name: Pulser Mk3
catalog.description: An IGF spy stole the Pulser MK1 concept. Their designers kept the base structure but added “Warp” projectile triggering for better energy use.

catalog.name: Warp Pulser
catalog.description: An IGF spy stole the Pulser MK1 concept. Their designers kept the base structure but added “Warp” projectile triggering for better energy use.

catalog.name: Warp Pulser Plus
catalog.description: An IGF spy stole the Pulser MK1 concept. Their designers kept the base structure but added “Warp” projectile triggering for better energy use.

catalog.name: Tower Gun
catalog.description: The HomeInSpace Company once used turrets as station defenses. Old Joe first mounted them on a ship, inspiring other raiders.

catalog.name: Standard Beam
catalog.description: A simple Cagetastic energy weapon, known for its commercial success and effectiveness against shields.

catalog.name: Internal Laser
catalog.description: Internal Laser

catalog.name: Recycled Standard Beam
catalog.description: A simple Cagetastic energy weapon, known for its commercial success and effectiveness against shields. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Old Joe's Beam
catalog.description: An entry-level laser by Entity, founded by raider Joe Santoro. Effective against shields.

catalog.name: Recycled Collimator H
catalog.description: After Cagetastic's cage success, the Empire invested heavily. Cagetastic repaid with the Collimator H, effective against shields. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Collimator H
catalog.description: After Cagetastic's success in cage construction, the Empire invested heavily in the company. Cagetastic repaid the trust with the Collimator H, effective against shields.

catalog.name: Large Laser (Premium)
catalog.description: Large Laser (Premium)

catalog.name: Recycled Maydeath
catalog.description: A mid-level rocket launcher built in the giant metal factories of the first space colonies in the Galaxy of Neterun. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Recycled Falxed
catalog.description: If a raider wants a rocket launcher, this is the best they can get. Many say firing a missile with the Falxed feels like becoming human again. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: RaidGun
catalog.description: Small automatic weapons mounted on raider bodies. Like most Imperial models, RaidGuns are supplied by Isaac Greyling Foundry.

catalog.name: K&B Actuator 999
catalog.description: Behl begged the Alchemist for a versatile material for a new weapon, the Actuator. The Alchemist refused until Kin offered him a side arm from a forgotten war.

catalog.name: InnerSun
catalog.description: Built by the TTF’s advanced AI before the incident with Imperial authorities. Uses sunyus tech to increase target accuracy.

catalog.name: OnsGun
catalog.description: An evolution of the RaidGun, created by Isaac Greyling Foundry using low-grade orichalcum. Some claimed it interfered with brainwaves. Greyling called it jealousy.

catalog.name: RaidGun
catalog.description: Small automatic weapons mounted on raider ships. Like most basic Imperial models, RaidGuns are supplied by Isaac Greyling Foundry.

catalog.name: Internal Gatling B
catalog.description: Internal Gatling B

catalog.name: K&B FrontierDream
catalog.description: When Kin proposed evolving their basic gatling, Behl hesitated. Kin showed him a raider effortlessly slaughtering aliens, then revealed the name. Behl was instantly convinced.

catalog.name: Recycled K&B FrontierDream
catalog.description: When Kin suggested improving their gatling, Behl doubted him. Then Kin showed a slaughter test, and the name. Behl was sold. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Large Gatling (Premium)
catalog.description: Large Gatling (Premium)

catalog.name: Recycled RocketMind
catalog.description: "When a raider with a gatling meets a raider with a rocket launcher, the gatling raider is a dead raider." With this claim, Toward The Future System announced the successful brain-linked rocket launcher. Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Raiderizer
catalog.description: An Imperial, lightweight rocket launcher. A stripped-down version of more powerful models.

catalog.name: Not Found
catalog.description: A defuse toolbox that can defuse explosive things.

catalog.name: K&B Gun
catalog.description: The first, glorious K&B model. Compact, easy to mount, used by every raider. "Freedom spree. K&B."

catalog.name: Recycled K&B Gun
catalog.description: The first, glorious K&B model. Compact, easy to mount, used by every raider. "Freedom spree. K&B." Recycled Module.

catalog.name: Faultysoul Z4
catalog.description: Said to be created by a Soul Landing prisoner before being accused of starting a riot and extracted. Marketed by Entity.

catalog.name: Faultysoul Z5
catalog.description: Used by many bounty hunter raiders. The Faultysoul Z5 was designed by a Soul Landing prisoner after witnessing her cellmate’s extraction.

catalog.name: Medium Gatling
catalog.description: Medium Gatling

catalog.name: TAI SHO-Gun
catalog.description: An advanced version of the SHO-Gun by TowardTheFuture Systems, conceived while its founders were intoxicated by their first exposure to sonic matter.

catalog.name: SHO-Gun
catalog.description: An entry-level sonic matter weapon. Rebext developed the Sonic HOpe Gun after extensive prison riot research at Soul Landing.

catalog.name: Spherical Harmon
catalog.description: "It is necessary to harness the resonance between sonic matter and the raider’s soul to reach the essence of the Galaxy." With these words, mystic Hedorn Orizein founded HomeInSpace and proposed this sonic matter shooter.

catalog.name: The Mundi
catalog.description: The perfect bond between human mind and sonic matter. Built through painful experiments on Soul Landing prisoners, the Mundi’s origin remains secret.

catalog.name: Scalphunter
catalog.description: Accuracy, power, speed. These were the Three Isotopes’ demands to the Iron Raiders when designing a guild gatling. Tested in a sortie against Gold Raiders, a total slaughter.

catalog.name: GodBeam
catalog.description: Result of gold nanoparticle research, this module lets Gold Raiders enhance Cagetastic’s laser weapons.

catalog.name: K&B Gun Mod 0
catalog.description: Against their research team’s advice, Kin & Behl created an alterable version of their famous gatling. Then fired the entire department.

catalog.name: K&B Gun Mod 1
catalog.description: Against their research team’s advice, Kin & Behl created an alterable version of their famous gatling. Then fired the entire department.

catalog.name: K&B Gun Mod 2
catalog.description: Against their research team’s advice, Kin & Behl created an alterable version of their famous gatling. Then fired the entire department.

catalog.name: K&B Gun Mod 3
catalog.description: Against their research team’s advice, Kin & Behl created an alterable version of their famous gatling. Then fired the entire department.

catalog.name: K&B Gun Mod 4
catalog.description: Against their research team’s advice, Kin & Behl created an alterable version of their famous gatling. Then fired the entire department.

catalog.name: Standard Beam Mod 0
catalog.description: A hacked version of Cagetastic’s Beam, for raiders seeking more from the base model. Effective against shields.

catalog.name: Balancer
catalog.description: The Tree Wars caused massive losses for both Malaxdon and Imperials. This module marked peace and guaranteed Tree ecosystem stability.

catalog.name: Honorary Balancer
catalog.description: The High Malaxdon built the Balancer to harvest sonic matter quickly and painlessly, preserving their cult’s ethics and alliance with the Empire.

catalog.name: Kindoom
catalog.description: An advanced Balancer made after HIS negotiated trade deals with the Malaxdon, securing Tree resources for the company.

catalog.name: Rocket Launcher Mod 0
catalog.description: "Any trouble, raider?" With this message, TTF announced their flagship rocket launcher was now upgradeable.

catalog.name: Enlighster
catalog.description: The ultimate Balancer module. Unauthorized by Yalda Nor, it's the result of The Alchemist's partnership with K&B and a successful bribe of the High Malaxdon.

catalog.name: Balancer Mod 0
catalog.description: An upgradeable Balancer, early prototype of an experimental module. Like the base version, it’s highly effective against Neterun’s creatures.

catalog.name: RRX
catalog.description: Tolec’s reward for weapons that blinded enemy teams during Tomorrow’s War. Alien tech finally let the company rival K&B.

catalog.name: RRX-2
catalog.description: Tolec gave RRX prototypes to Imperial colonists for testing. They enhanced them with Orichalcum, wiping out insurgents and prompting immediate production of the improved model.

catalog.name: Aheadisk
catalog.description: The Tomorrow’s Wars let the Empire steal Pterost tech and sell it to the highest bidder. Entity used the parts to craft this engine.

catalog.name: Haze Piston
catalog.description: I was never born. Then I was born dead. Who did this to me? Now I can get back on the move.

catalog.name: Prism - Lapis Drive
catalog.description: Silent like the Mhafek homeworld.

catalog.name: Prism - Clear Laser
catalog.description: Iridescent like a Mhafek’s thoughts.

catalog.name: Prism - Opaline Launcher
catalog.description: Brutal like the Mhafek’s memories.

catalog.name: Helicon - DB Thruster I
catalog.description: Project One Record Mind-sonic matter experiments ongoing with an unaffiliated prisoner. The subject killed two of my colleagues. Noted anomalous traits, suggestive of multiple personalities.

catalog.name: Helicon Weaponry ++
catalog.description: Development Ones Record The subject responded appropriately. Sonic matter preserves fundamental mind data. The subject's anomalous screams are aiding in the calibration of their brain waves.

catalog.name: Helicon Thruster II
catalog.description: Project One Record Mind-sonic matter experiments ongoing with an unaffiliated prisoner. The subject killed two of my colleagues. Noted anomalous traits, suggestive of multiple personalities.

catalog.name: Helicon Weaponry +
catalog.description: Project One Record The subject's mind has vanished; we don't know how. Fortunately, we have other Raider Ones, and the Imperial Family was pleas...

catalog.name: Serkor
catalog.description: A smuggler once offered the Gold Guild leader pieces of ancient Neterunian tech. Inspired by the whispers he heard, he built the Sekor weapon.

catalog.name: Wastemaker
catalog.description: The last Hole Wars saw countless Gold Raider deaths, made possible largely by this trusted Iron Guild gatling.

catalog.name: Kubeam
catalog.description: When the Gold Guild leader first used the Kubeam, his brainwaves were said to be infused with golden particles, at least according to Cagetastic, its creator.

catalog.name: Iron Sage
catalog.description: An engine built during one of the Iron Guild’s dominant eras, beginning when the Great Apostate destroyed several primitive Gold Harvest Pyramids.

catalog.name: Collimator Fe-1
catalog.description: Originally an industrial tool for raider bodies production, this laser was soon repurposed into a devastating weapon. Just like everything else the raiders touch.

catalog.name: K&B Beamplier
catalog.description: "Lasers don't blow targets to pieces," Behl said, before Kin seduced Abby away from Abby's Shields. Now there's the K&B Beamplier, and it blows targets to pieces.

catalog.name: Iron Arm Green to Double Red
Gold Arm Green to Double Red
Raidgun 230A
catalog.description: It took Isaac Greyling exactly 229 tests to upgrade his RaidGun. Half that number might have been enough, but why pass up Imperial funding?

catalog.name: Flexxor Z10
catalog.description: Removing the seat belts from the old Z9 gave it a new lease on life.

catalog.name: Warp Focalizer
catalog.description: Neural data from Imperials driven mad in connecting suites was used to forge this module's mind-engine interface.

catalog.name: HS Thruster
catalog.description: Project One Record ..ed. We've bottled minds as messages, cast into a sea of stars. May that sea welcome my memories.

catalog.name: Flare Drive
catalog.description: Everything shimmered inside a Mhafek’s body. Just like this engine.

catalog.name: IG9
catalog.description: A miniature Irongine, crafted as a memento for the raider who became the Iron leader.

catalog.name: CW-6S1
catalog.description: May your mind flow as freely as gold, or so says a teaching of the golden god.
